newrow.name: Stitch Drone
newrow.description: Channels a 10 HP repair to one wounded ordinary ally within 150 px. Cannot repair bosses, summons or support drones.
newrow.tell: Cyan dashed tether and four-notch progress mark a 1.2 s repair; any actual damage to the drone interrupts it.
newrow.dodge: Hit the drone, finish its ally or separate them beyond the tether. It has no damage immunity. Warning and recovery are contact-safe.
